Priya S: Heads-up — ACME Galaxy POC streaming is intermittently stalling and clients are hitting 429s once we get to ~120 concurrent streams. Opening thread to swarm.
Alex W: On it. Any logs or repro steps?
Samir K: I can join. What SDK/lang are they using?
Priya S: Node (official SDK), streaming via event source. Repro: ~5 req/s per user, ~120 total concurrent streams. Client shows 429 RateLimitExceeded from edge, then ReadTimeout after ~10s. Customer uses corporate SSO reverse proxy in front of our endpoint.
Alex W: Suspect connection pool exhaustion + proxy handshake behavior. Can you paste client config?
Priya S: ```js
// client config snippet
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  timeoutMs: 10000, // 10s
  streaming: true,
  maxRetries: 2,
  httpAgentOptions: { keepAlive: true, maxSockets: 100 }
});
```
DevEx: Server logs show many ECONNRESET and TCP_CLOSE shortly after accept. Could be proxy tearing connections (no reuse) so edge sees lots of short-lived connections.
Jen T: FYI we saw this with NTLM/SSO proxies — they often do per-connection handshake which prevents HTTP/2 multiplexing. Leads to many concurrent connections and triggers our per-customer QPS guardrails. Workarounds: enable session affinity at proxy, or use TLS passthrough so our edge sees client TLS.
Alex W: Quick mitigation: (1) bump client timeout to 30s, (2) reduce per-client concurrency (eg 50 streams), (3) disable streaming for heavy-load tests. Longer term: ask customer infra to allow connection reuse/session affinity.
Priya S: Trying timeout=30000 and bumping socket pool to 200 now. Running load test.
PresalesBot: Action created -> /poc-run --rps 5 --concurrency 120 --tag acme-galaxy (assigned to Priya S).
Priya S: Update: after increasing timeout we saw fewer ReadTimeouts but still 429s at ~180 concurrent streams. Edge logs show "request quota exceeded" with code RATE_LIMIT per-customer.
Samir K: That's our soft per-customer QPS cap for hosted POCs. I can temporarily raise the quota for acme-galaxy to 500 QPS while they run the POC. Doing the bump now.
Samir K: Done — quota increased. Please re-run.
Priya S: Re-run started. 10 minutes in — no 429s, streaming stalls gone. Model hosts CPU higher but within limits. Looks like quota + proxy handshake were both contributing. :white_check_mark:
Jen T: I'll open a ticket with ACME infra to recommend NTLM bypass for our endpoint (or TLS passthrough / session affinity). Also recommending Dedicated for production to avoid shared limits.
DevEx: I'll draft a short doc: "SSO reverse proxies + streaming best practices" with config examples and add it to the presales playbook.
Priya S: Thanks all. Follow-ups: Samir keeps temp quota until POC end, Jen owns ACME infra contact, DevEx produces doc, I will update presales notes and confirm customer runs final verification later today.
Alex W: Nice triage. If they still need streaming at scale we can propose Dedicated + pinned capacity + private deployment to avoid QPS interference.
Priya S: Will propose that in the next call. Closing thread for now, will reopen if we get new errors.
